recalled_knowledge.item: Gamma-Poisson (negative-binomial) predictive: for s ~ Gamma(a, theta) the count in k units has P(N) = nbinom(a, p = 1/(1 + k theta)); Exponential(1) = Gamma(1,1) gives P(N|k) = k^N/(1+k)^(N+1)
Exact-Poisson counting significance Z = Phi^-1(1 - P(>=N | b)); 5 sigma one-sided threshold 2.87e-7
Conversion of decimal years to calendar months (2027.60 = Aug 2027, 2030.84 = Nov 2030)

Reproducing P081's 55-270 keV and 270-420 keV DM probabilities from band ratios with a single Gamma failed (those windows are dominated by the delta >= 366 keV tail of P081's 298-spectrum mixture); P081's values are quoted directly for those windows.
The single-Gamma match to P081's posterior gives E(P>=1 = 0.9) = 261 t.yr against P081's 123 t.yr (heavier low-rate tail); both quoted as a bracket.
P088's LZ-1000 phd null-branch date (2027.69, L10) is reproduced only to 0.9 yr (ours 2028.55) because P088 dates on-disk exposure by accrual and marginalises with toys; flagged rather than pursued.
